one_line_pitch_to_sam: It's a fighting game on a grey floor where the corner of the screen snitches on everything you do, and there's a bench that launches you into the sky, but you've done it all in twenty minutes.

moments.why: The plain baseplate start got a tease at the time but was nothing to retell, only a vague 'grey floor' later.
Goblin-mode sneak attack on Kai at the dummy was Robin's biggest laugh and Kai's real outrage.
'(beat Kai!)' on Kai's own screen turned the climb into a four-minute rivalry with real times to brag about.
Superhero landing with screen shake, done together, was a shared wow.
Swimming was just water with nothing in it.
Being launched into the sky and the pool was the loudest moment; the unbeatable splash record is the one gripe.
Punching air with no sound was fine and felt like nothing.
Hitting the dummy was task-mode with no reaction.
The combo launch was fun in the first minute but got overwritten once swords took over.
Robin kicking Kai off the tower mid record run stuck as a prank story.
Landing the parry after four tries felt like actual skill to Kai.
Equipping the sword was exciting for a second but is just 'there's a sword' now.
Remembered only as the complaint that the sword beats punching so fights are who clicks first.
The dummy only survives as the place Kai got sneak-attacked; the solo record went flat with nobody competing.
The first hit-freeze impressed Kai then but blended into general fighting.
'Into a nap' feed lines and the 6-3 score are the brag, but they don't want more samey duels.
The failed parry attempts collapsed into 'it took me four tries'.
Silent synced dance was cute for ten seconds then awkward and forgettable.
The feed snitching on laugh, bye-bye wave and slow clap made the taunts hilarious.
The 'no emote called flex' message was a small let-down with no story in it.
The dance stopping when you walk was never noticed as a thing.
'Robin was left hanging' in the feed, twice, is the funny part; the high five that worked is not what got retold.
An NPC standing there vibing registered as nothing.
Empty floor and falling off the world gave one small laugh and no memory.
The rivalry board is remembered fondly, but the lasting takeaway is no rounds, shop or unlocks so nothing else to do.
